data: What type of metrics are used?

The caption states that the lower values are better for all metrics. The figure shows two types of metrics: Local metrics and Global metrics. The Local metrics are represented in Figure 4a, while the Global metrics are represented in Figure 4b. The metrics are measured along the y-axis, and the x-axis represents either Negative BLEU-5 or LM score. The lines represent different models, including MLE, FM-GAN, RL-GAN, and others. The caption also mentions that MLE under a temperature sweep achieves better quality-diversity trade-off compared to the GAN approaches. Therefore, the metrics used in the figure are both local and global, and they are measured along the y-axis.
